Expected turns, guessing directly: 1/3 × 1 + 1/3 × 2 + 1/3 × 3 = 2.
Expected turns, asking first: with probability 1/3 the answer isolates the object, so 2 turns total. With probability 2/3 two remain, so 1 question plus 1.5 guesses on average = 2.5. That averages about 2.33.

Guessing directly is better.
